history.p: When Gade finished "The Crusaders" in March 1866, he marked it "Opus 50" leaving opus 48 and 49 free, probably because he already then had planned to make it the final part of a trilogy together with "Kalanus" (NWGW 174) and "Zion" (NWGW 177).

incipText.p: Hedt bølger Sandet, guult som Flammer
Heiss wogt das Sandmeer, gelb wie Flammen
Snart vort Øie skuer Maalet
Bald zum Ziel wird Gott uns tragen
Straal, høie Sol, straal paa mit Sværd med Lyst!
Strahl' hehre Sonn' strahl auf mein Schwert mit Lust!
Herre, fra det Fjerne drog din Skare hid
Vater, aus der Ferne zog dein Heer herbei
Nu snoer Natten sig mørk om den dødstille Ørk
Schleichend listig und sacht kommt das Dunkel der Nacht
De slumre trygt i Nattens svale Fred!
Sie schlafen sanft in friedlich kühler Nacht!

expression.tempo: Allegro maestoso - Allegro moderato - Allegro maestoso

incipText.p: Jeg dukker mit Bryst, jeg dukker min Kind
Ich tauch' meine Brust, die Wange so lind
Vaagn, Rinaldo, vaagn af din Slummer!
O, Rinaldo, auf, Rinaldo, auf, erwache!

expression.tempo: Andantino sostenuto - Allegro grazioso - Moderato - Allegro grazioso - Moderato - Allegro - Allegro moderato

incipText.p: Alt breder sig den lyse Sky
Im Ost die Sonne nahet schon
Med hellig Hu, til Maalet nu!
Mit heilgem Sinn zum Heilgen Ziel!
Fremad, fremad frem nu min mødige Fod
Weiter, weiter! weiter mein müder Fuss
Løft høit dit Hoved, Korsmand, stands!
Dein Haupt erhebe, Kreuzmann, steh!

expression.tempo: Maestoso - Allegro marcato - Andante - Allegro marcato - Allegro vivace

physDesc.physMedium: In grey cardboard cover. Written in ink. Paper: 14 staves. Verso of title page blank; then a second title page also inscribed "Skizze / til Korsfarerne. / Op. 50." followed by two blank pages and a music page. Heading on the first numbered music page: "No 1. / I Ørkenen." and the dating "(d. 22 Juli 65)". Part One paginated 1-14; Part Two paginated 1-21. Heading on p. 1: "II / Armida. / No. 5 and the dating: "(19 August 65)". End-dated on p. 21 "(14 September / 65.)". Part III paginated 4-16. Heading on the first unnumbered page: "III. / Mod Jerusalem" and the dating "25 Dec. 1865 / (Juul)." After the last double bar on p. 16 Gade has written: "S.D.G. / Fine / d. 17 Januar 1866" and his musical signature. Last four pages blank.

physLoc.identifier: C II, 6 Gades Samling 315 (Kapsel K - L), C Fol.

physDesc.physMedium: 1 single folio. Written in ink. Paper: 20 staves. Paginated (5) and (6) which indicates that is was part of a now lost draft. On p. 5 the last 16 bars of no. 2; on p. 6 no. 3 complete.

physLoc.identifier: HA: Collins Samling 120 Fol. C II, 139

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in grey cardboard cover. Written in ink. Paper: 20 staves. Paginated 1-210. In upper right-hand corner on p. 1 "Korsfarerne / Op. 50. / (Die Kreuzfahrer).". With Danish and German text. Part One end-dated "Jan. 66"; Part Two end-dated "October 1865". At the end of the music on p. 210 Gade has written: "Fine / Martz 1866. / (Paaskeaften.) / S.D.G." and his musical signature.
Drafts and fair copies of the text in Gade's and Carl Andersen's hand.
